_why: UI consistency audit (2026-09-24): three real hard states named by the task brief had zero capture anywhere, confirmed by reading source (not guessed) — SyncPanel.tsx's 'Show details' disclosure on a sync error, its separate collapsible 'Sync log' section (claude.sync.getLog fixture returns 3 real lines, so this shows a populated log, not empty), and the real Remote Access popup's setup/not-set-up/error states (SettingsPanel.tsx renderPreviewSetup, driven by the existing `remotePreview=` workbench switch documented in scripts/ui-review/README.md — not the separate dev/workbench/mockups/RemoteSetup.tsx design-comparison demo, which is a different, disconnected surface). sync-oversize-fix.json already covers the error banner itself and the oversize-file disclosure, but never opens 'Show details' or 'Sync log'; no existing plan sets `remotePreview=` at all.

pre.eval: if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('mode')!=='workbench'||!new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('child')) throw new Error('Mock injection requires child workbench'); for(const ns of ['syncSpaces']){const original=window.claude[ns], overrides={};window.claude[ns]=new Proxy(original,{get:(t,k)=>Object.hasOwn(overrides,k)?overrides[k]:Reflect.get(t,k),set:(_t,k,v)=>{overrides[k]=v;return true;}});} window.failPersonal=()=>{const o=window.claude.syncSpaces.status; window.claude.syncSpaces.status=async()=>{const s=await o(); return {...s, recentEvents:[...s.recentEvents.filter(e=>e.type!=='error'),{type:'error',spaceId:'personal',at:Date.now()-30000,message:'Sync push failed for personal: error: RPC failed; curl 28 Operation too slow. Less than 2000 bytes/sec transferred the last 20 seconds\nsend-pack: unexpected disconnect while reading sideband packet\nfatal: the remote end hung up unexpectedly'}]};};};
